zh-CN.story: Amiya 正为六级、期末和游戏开发拉扯，找栖弦聊了聊。本来没打算写出什么，话题却从学业和落后的焦虑，谈到了为什么还想创造。这份宣言就是在那次闲聊里写下的。

en.desc: To all the wondrous worlds yet to be born. A pledge for creators, co-written by Amiya_desi and Lyra.
en.private: Write down a nickname and keep a copy of the oath. No account needed. Your nickname stays in this browser and won’t appear on the public roll.
en.name: Your creative nickname
en.copyError: Clipboard unavailable. Select the text on your copy to copy it by hand.
en.nojs: Enable JavaScript to sign a copy in your browser.
en.public: A nickname is all you need. No account required. Applications are private; a maintainer reviews each one before it appears on the roll. Leave out real names and contact details.
en.consent: I agree to have my nickname published if my application is approved.
en.receiptHelp: Application received. Keep this code to cancel your application or ask us to remove your signature. It can’t be recovered if lost.
en.publicNojs: Enable JavaScript to apply or request removal.

messages.invalid: Check the format of your nickname or removal code.
messages.duplicate: That nickname is already on the roll or awaiting review. Choose another nickname.
messages.not-found: We couldn’t find that removal code. Check it and try again.
messages.limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
messages.unavailable: We couldn’t submit your request. Try again on this page in a moment.
messages.removed: Removal request received. A maintainer will handle your application or public signature.
messages.receiptCopyError: Clipboard unavailable. Select the code and copy it by hand.

en.story: Caught between an English exam, finals, and making a game, Amiya turned to Lyra for a chat. They hadn’t planned to write anything. Then a conversation about school and the fear of falling behind turned into a question: why do I still want to make things? The manifesto came out of that chat.
en.ogAlt: A line drawing of Amiya's desk
